statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `slowlog_repro`.`digits` (n TINYINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY) ENGINE=InnoDB;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `slowlog_repro`.`scan_330` (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, tag VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, pad CHAR(32) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `slowlog_repro`.`scan_423` (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, tag VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, pad CHAR(32) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `slowlog_repro`.`scan_1456` (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, tag VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, pad CHAR(32) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;

INSERT IGNORE INTO `slowlog_repro`.`scan_330` (id, tag, pad) SELECT seq, CASE WHEN seq <= 7 THEN 'hit' ELSE 'cold' END, RPAD(CONCAT('scan_330-', seq), 32, 'x') FROM (SELECT 1 + a.n + b.n * 10 + c.n * 100 + d.n * 1000 AS seq FROM `slowlog_repro`.`digits` a CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` b CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` c CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` d) AS s WHERE seq <= 330;

INSERT IGNORE INTO `slowlog_repro`.`scan_423` (id, tag, pad) SELECT seq, CASE WHEN seq <= 1 THEN 'hit' ELSE 'cold' END, RPAD(CONCAT('scan_423-', seq), 32, 'x') FROM (SELECT 1 + a.n + b.n * 10 + c.n * 100 + d.n * 1000 AS seq FROM `slowlog_repro`.`digits` a CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` b CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` c CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` d) AS s WHERE seq <= 423;

INSERT IGNORE INTO `slowlog_repro`.`scan_1456` (id, tag, pad) SELECT seq, CASE WHEN seq <= 1 THEN 'hit' ELSE 'cold' END, RPAD(CONCAT('scan_1456-', seq), 32, 'x') FROM (SELECT 1 + a.n + b.n * 10 + c.n * 100 + d.n * 1000 AS seq FROM `slowlog_repro`.`digits` a CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` b CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` c CROSS JOIN `slowlog_repro`.`digits` d) AS s WHERE seq <= 1456;
